# NFL Daily — 2026-11-12 (Past 1 day)

## Summary
- Vikings traded for QB Kirk Cousins from the Raiders ahead of the deadline, reuniting him with coach Kevin O'Connell. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50444528/kirk-cousins-trade-minnesota-vikings-las-vegas-raiders)
- Raiders named rookie QB Fernando Mendoza their starter after trading Cousins to Minnesota. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50456405/fernando-mendoza-relishes-once-life-opportunity-raiders-starting-qb)
- Colts traded away WRs Josh Downs and Keenan Allen at the deadline, keeping RB Jonathan Taylor as their top remaining piece. [The Athletic](https://www.nytimes.com/athletic/7771590/2026/11/12/nfl-trade-deadline-2026-winners-losers/)
- Broncos' trade for Chargers LB Daiyan Henley collapsed over medical concerns about his knee; Chargers coach Jim Harbaugh accused Denver of using it to leverage a better deal. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50459330/broncos-say-trade-chargers-lb-henley-not-finalized) — also [Schefter]

## Transactions
- _No qualifying transactions in this window._

## Injuries
- Lions QB Jared Goff (chest) is questionable, limited at Wednesday's practice. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/injuries)
- Packers DE Micah Parsons (knee/illness) is out, limited at Wednesday's session. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/injuries)
- Packers RB Josh Jacobs is out. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/injuries)
- Lions WR Amon-Ra St. Brown (ribs) is questionable, limited at practice. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/injuries)
- Lions S Kerby Joseph (knee) is out, limited at Wednesday's practice. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/injuries)
- Rams WR Davante Adams (hamstring) is targeting a Week 13 return; fellow WR Puka Nacua (knee/toe) is expected out for an extended period. [The Athletic](https://www.nytimes.com/athletic/7774400/2026/11/11/rams-davante-adams-return-puka-nacua-injury/)

# Baltimore Ravens — 2026-11-12 (Past 1 day)

## Key news
- Jacoby Brissett is set to start for Baltimore "until Lamar Jackson can return at the end of the season," per the Ravens beat. [Hensley](https://x.com/jamisonhensley/status/2120977113893535778)
- Ravens signed K Riley Patterson to the 53-man roster after Jake Moody was poached off the practice squad by another team, and added Harrison Mevis to the practice squad as insurance; Patterson will kick Monday night against the Chargers. [Ravens.com](https://www.baltimoreravens.com/news/ravens-sign-kicker-riley-patterson-jake-moody-tyler-loop-2026) — also [Rapoport]
- Ravens are weighing lineup changes for Monday's "reset" vs. the Chargers — including possibly benching CB Marlon Humphrey for more safety snaps from Kyle Hamilton — as big-money veterans Humphrey, Mark Andrews and Ronnie Stanley face scrutiny for the team's slide. [The Banner](https://www.thebanner.com/sports/ravens-nfl/ravens-marlon-humphrey-jesse-minter-chargers-bench-FE2RVEVYERGHNPYIA3IJV4EU2U/) — also [The Athletic]

# Rivals — 2026-11-12 (Past 1 day)

## Summary
- Steelers HC Mike Tomlin reaffirmed he isn't considering a coaching return, content in his new role at NBC Sports. [PennLive](https://www.pennlive.com/steelers/2026/11/mike-tomlin-could-be-the-hottest-coaching-candidate-for-teams-but-theres-a-surprising-twist-to-his-future-plans.html)
- Steelers missed the trade deadline on a receiver upgrade; coach Mike McCarthy says he isn't worried, citing the near-returns of WRs Michael Pittman Jr., Roman Wilson and Max Hurleman from injury. [PennLive](https://www.pennlive.com/steelers/2026/11/pittsburgh-steelers-fans-might-be-disappointed-but-mike-mccarthy-isnt-worried-about-missing-the-trade-deadline.html) — also [The Athletic]
- Bengals' trade-deadline deal for Eagles DE Arnold Ebiketie collapsed; coach Zac Taylor took the blame, calling it "on our end." [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50454351/bengals-zac-taylor-apologizes-failed-trade-eagles)
- Chiefs acquired WR Josh Downs from the Colts at the trade deadline. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50442897/2026-trade-deadline-barnwell-questions-cousins-downs) — also [The Athletic]
- Browns DE Jared Verse said he met with the team psychiatrist to work through a sack slump. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/story/_/id/50463010/browns-jared-verse-met-psychiatrist-end-sack-slump)

## Transactions
- _No qualifying transactions in this window._

## Injuries
- Chiefs QB Patrick Mahomes (elbow/knee) is questionable but was a full participant in Wednesday's practice. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/injuries)
- Bills OT Dion Dawkins (ribs) is questionable, limited in Wednesday's walkthrough. [ESPN](https://www.espn.com/nfl/injuries)
- Steelers DT Derrick Harmon (foot) is trending toward a return Sunday after being designated for return from IR. [PennLive](https://www.pennlive.com/steelers/2026/11/steelers-star-says-hes-not-pushing-to-play-but-all-signs-point-to-a-return-this-sunday.html)
